item.description:
# Now 2.13.78
- Podcast transcripts should now actually appear. The episode identifier that locates the transcript was being lost one step before it was used: the track is copied just before the lyrics are looked up, and that copy was not carrying the identifier across. Added a test covering the whole path from the player to the file, since this is the second way the identifier has gone missing.

# Now 2.13.77
- Fixes podcast transcripts never appearing. The episode identifier used to find the transcript arrives as a number, and was being read as text, so it came through empty every time and the transcript was never looked up. Verified end to end against a real episode.

# Now 2.13.76
- Apple Podcasts transcripts, shown line by line and word by word exactly like lyrics, in the overlay and in full screen. Turn it on under Lyrics in Settings. - It is off by default and asks nothing of you until you switch it on. Podcasts keeps transcripts in a protected folder, so reading them needs Full Disk Access, which is far too much to ask of anyone who just wants a now playing widget. Switch it on and Settings explains what to grant and why. Nothing leaves your Mac: the file Podcasts has already downloaded is read locally.
